notes.title: Watch Our GDC Talk: The Journey Behind Little Learning Machines
notes.notes:
Not only was Little Learning Machines selected as one of the GDC Best In Play titles, but the game’s Co-Directors, Nick Counter and Dante Camarena, also had the opportunity to share insights from its development during the AI Summit at GDC 2024. They reflected on the creative and technical journey of transforming neural network training into a fun, accessible player experience.

We're excited to share that the full recording of their presentation, "Little Learning Machines Postmortem: A Game About Training Neural Networks," is now live on GDC’s YouTube Channel! If you’re curious about the making of the game, this is a must-watch.

To celebrate, Little Learning Machines is currently 40% off on Steam — be sure to check it out. Happy training! 🧠 🤖

[previewyoutube=o_NGucEip08;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bonus Content Update!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to bring you a fantastic new update packed with fresh content and improvements! Dive into 18 new bonus islands, explore new customization options, and experience a more polished and localized gameplay. Check out the details below and get ready to enhance your Little Learning Machines adventure!

[h2][b]New Features:[/b][/h2]

-[b]18 New Bonus Islands & Quests: [/b]Added a variety of new environments and challenges, enhancing gameplay with fresh objectives and exploration opportunities.
- [b]6 New Costumes & Cosmetics:[/b] Introduced new customization options for players to personalize their Animo.
- [b]New World Map:[/b] Ooh, so pretty.

[h2][b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b][/h2]

- [b]Localization:[/b] Little Learning Machines is now localized in French and Spanish (LATAM)!
- [b]New Achievements:[/b] New Achievements based on bonus content have been added with cosmetic rewards!

[h2][b]Bug Fixes & Visual Updates:[/b][/h2]

- Resolved multiple issues with missing text, typos, and other mishaps related to quests and and the info panel.
- [b]Updated Animation Controllers:[/b] Updated controllers and components to improve gameplay mechanics, functionality, and performance.

Again, as always, thank you for playing Little Learning Machines 🤖

notes.title: Patch notes for build #59.
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Animo-aniacs![/h2]
First off, welcome to all the new players that joined us! If you want to report a bug, give feedback, or some help or hints on solving some of the puzzles, head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/CCBKR7rsK6]Discord server![/url] 
As for today's patch, we fixed that pesky tutorial dialogue bug! Took a few tries but we got it. Just a few more localization fixes, UI fixes, and potentially game breaking scenarios got patched up. Here are the full patch notes:

[h2]Bugs Fixed:[/h2]
[list][*] Certain parts of the second Tutorial quest dialogue was using outdated dialogue have now been updated and localized.
[*] Reward phrasing now properly updates on all languages and when languages are changed.
[*] Tooltips now display properly in all languages.
[*] Animo are no longer able to be reset during the tutorial.
[*] Quest bubbles now display properly over quest points and will properly track Animo completing a quest.
[*] Quest Complete and Failed are now properly localized.
[*] Language menu is now localized.
[/list]
As always, thanks for playing Little Learning Machines 🤖🤖🤖

notes.title: Official launch! Patch #54 notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello friends,[/h2]
We're happy to announce that "Little Learning Machines" is officially launching out of Early Access! A big thank you to our incredible community for your invaluable feedback and support throughout this journey. You have helped shape the game into what it is today - a whimsical world of AI companionship and discovery. As we step into this new chapter, we're excited to bring more features, challenges, and magical moments.

Thank you so much for following alongside us on this journey, your support has been an essential part of this adventure! Enjoy the adventures with your new AI Companions! 🤖 ❤️ 🧠

- The Little Learning Machines Team

[h3]Features added:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Localization for Simplified Chinese, German, and Korean has been added
[/list]
[h3]Bugs Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Maps for Soccer Sands and Azure Abyss have been updated.
[*]Menu display issues caused by incorrect fonts have been fixed.
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rapidly changing languages will cause issues in Reward phrasing in the Training Cloud
[*]Resetting the Animo’s brain during the tutorial will render the Animo unlikely to pass the tutorial quests (don’t do this, please! 😢).
[*]The achievement “Artifical Archeologist” may unexpectedly unlock.
[*]Under certain circumstances, the tooltip length will remain at its max size and not wrap the text correctly.
[*]Under certain circumstances, during the second quest of the tutorial, the dialogue will use older, unlocalized text for all langauges.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for Build #52 and #53
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Here's what we've cooked up in the latest update, if you're interested in reading about the changes check out this list of bug fixes and features below! ːsteamhappyː

[h2]Features added:
[/h2]
- Achievements added
- Title screen functionality was added

[h2]Bugs Fixed:[/h2]

- Animo Portait / Photobooth greyscale issues were fixed
- When Animo were being penalized, the incorrect face was displayed
- Intro animations leading to title screen was fixed
- When Cosmetic is unlocked, no audio played was fixed
- Tree destroy animation did not display correctly under certain conditions
- Tooltips did not display correctly under certain conditions
- Training Graph no longer lingers when Animo brain is reset
- Quest bubbles no longer linger when you switch maps
- Interaction between axe and dog has been fixed
- Fixed null dialogue when unlocking 9th Animo
- Fixed Obstacle icon in training
- Fixed ground shader for Macs
- Blossom Bluff unlocking was fixed
- 9th Animo unlocked was fixed
- Error screen from lack of pip cache after initial installation has been resolved
- Achievements now pop up with STEAM’s UI when earned
- Vision offset issue on Cottage Cove, Magma Mountain, Azure Abyss, and Winter Resort has been resolved
- Quest Completion particle effects now display correctly
- Clear Save Data button now displays correct UI elements
- Item names, descriptions, and variant descriptions now stack nicely

Thank you for playing Little Learning Machines :)

notes.title: Little Learning Machines Live: Advanced Multi-Animo Training

You won't want to miss this!! Tune in LIVE on November 15th at 1 PM EST / 10 AM PST ✨

notes.title: Little Learning Machines LIVE : Start Training your Little Machines
notes.notes:
Don't miss the upcoming special live-streamed Steam event where you'll uncover the secrets to mastering training in Little Learning Machines. 

Join Community Manager Fiona and Co-directors Dante Camarena and Nick Counter, as they walk you through the intricacies of no-code neural network training and optimizing early-game strategies. Watch live demos, learn about the unique quests and get valuable tips to enhance your gameplay. 

Plus, interact with us and we’ll answer your questions live.

See you on November 8th at 1 PM EST (10 AM PST) 🎊

notes.title: Live Stream - All About Little Learning Machines!
notes.notes:
Join us on [b]October 25th at 5 PM EST (2 PM PST)[/b] for an exciting live-streamed event on Steam: All About Little Learning Machines - now in Early Access! Meet the co-directors, Dante Camarena and Nick Counter, as they dive into the details behind Little Learning Machines. 

Tune in to learn more about the game's narrative, how each Little Learning Machine is a real neural network, explore the concepts of love and fear within the game, understand the use of rewards, and gain insights into AI training. 

Plus, participate in an engaging discussion with the game's creators. Feel free to bring any questions you have in mind! 

We hope to see you there!
